title: Monthly Raku Firing Workshop
source_quote: Upcoming Dates: April 17th - Obvara & Slip Resist May 16th June 13th July 18th August 15th September 19th October 24th November 14th
evidence_sentence: The raku firing workshop page lists monthly firing dates from April through November where potters bring bisque and experience raku firing in the kiln.
evidence_quote: During our monthly workshop we will fire your pieces to Brilliant and Exciting Colors... Pots are glazed firing in Raku kiln pulled out at 1850 degrees placed in shredded paper, set on fire
cost_text: $10.00 seating fee plus price of firing which will vary by size
bring: Your own pottery bisque to Cone 08 (1750) or purchase pottery pots
how_to_join: Call Wanda Clarke at Dakota Potters Supply (605) 332-1946
commitment: Workshop starts at 9:00 AM; each kiln round takes about 1 hour
summary: Monthly raku firing workshops open to ages 5 and up where you bring bisque pieces and experience raku firing with various techniques including horse hair and ferric spray. Sign-up fee is $10 plus firing cost.
pay_text: $10.00 seating fee plus price of firing which will vary by size
